ownership.boundary_note: Missing-pad and source-validation semantics inside the stage consumer belong to the native_parcel_stage/runtime worker; the RPC session's own admission contract belongs to this review.

validated_axes.evidence: native_parcel_rpc.py transition(): received_at is the enclosing service's `now` argument (its actual clock), never a caller field; request.issued_at must equal `now` (line ~192); runtime admit_action re-checks received_at/now relation (native_parcel_runtime.py:1241) and rejects future vs past reception. Test test_rpc_uses_current_closed_tick_and_independent_principal pins `now` to the current closed stage.

AdmittedParcelAction.rx_stage_barrier_digest is copied from self.batch.source_stage_barrier_digest — the previously accepted closed-stage barrier — not from the request (native_parcel_rpc.py:202); runtime re-binds it against the contiguous closing barrier (native_parcel_runtime.py:1407).

transition() rejects foreign run_id; tool_id must map to pickup/dropoff; arguments must name exactly order_id/parcel_id/actor_id of contract.identities; request.agent_id must equal ids.authorized_principal_id (independent principal binding, native_parcel_runtime.py:698 re-check). Record validator NativeParcelActionRecord.command_binding re-binds run/command/principal/tool/payload/outcome digests.

First admission persists canonical_json_bytes(request) under key (run_id, agent_id, command_id) BEFORE admitting; same key + identical payload returns the original record verbatim; same key + different content raises 'reused with different request content'. Test test_same_request_returns_original_and_payload_reuse_rejected covers both. Stage-level batch re-delivery dedup is tombstoned by (run_id, at) in native_parcel_stage.consume_batch.

transition() requires now == self.batch.at (the last ingested closed stage); admission proceeds only against the current closed observation stage. Test pins transition(now=tick+1) as ValueError 'current closed'.

validated_axes.axis: pose and source bindings of the projection
validated_axes.evidence: projection() derives the carrier pose via runtime parcel_carriage_pose from the exact batch observation when custody is carrier-held, else uses the declared resting pose; NativeParcelSceneFrame.same_closed_native_stage re-binds run/scenario/scene-state digest/stage-barrier between SceneState and projection; projection carries source_scene_state_digest, source_stage_barrier_digest, source_observation_digest.

ingest_closed_stage rejects foreign run/scenario, violates of declared step_ns clock (sim_time_ns != tick*step_ns) and max_steps, and any record whose facility/pad geometry differs from the compiled pads.

RPC accepted a batch covering only one declared pad because the stage surface deliberately admits single-pad stages (len(observations) > 1 guard, native_parcel_stage.py:158; its own tests consume _batch(pickup)). A pickup-only batch then mutated the machine (dwell incremented) before any rejection and became the projection source — breaking the session's atomicity contract. Fixed in native_parcel_rpc.py ingest_closed_stage: the session now requires the exact declared pad set {(pickup_facility, pickup_pad_index), (dropoff_facility, dropoff_pad_index)} covered exactly once, checked BEFORE consume_batch, so rejection is fully atomic (machine snapshot unchanged, batch not consumed).

validated_axes.axis: cross-pad source consistency of one sample
validated_axes.evidence: A source sample assessed against the far dropoff pad (h._observation(..., facility_id=h._DROPOFF) reusing the pickup-side sample fields) is absorbed by observe() without a cross-pad consistency check; the remaining failure of test_batch_missing_pad_wrong_pose_and_tick_jump_are_atomic (second sub-case, line ~143) demonstrates it. Per the ownership boundary this is native_parcel_stage/native_parcel_runtime source-validation work (missing-pad/source-validation failures belong there). Handoff: either assess each source sample per-pad or reject samples whose digest duplicates another pad's source evidence.

defects_fixed.change: ingest_closed_stage now enforces the session's full declared pad set (exactly one record per declared facility/pad) before stage consumption; error message names covered vs declared pads.
defects_fixed.test_added: tests/tasks/test_native_parcel_rpc.py::test_rpc_session_requires_every_declared_pad_per_stage — pickup-only batch rejected atomically (snapshot unchanged, rpc.batch is None); duplicated-record batch rejected; full batch accepted and projection shows awaiting_pickup.

blocking_for_owner.item: Cross-pad source-sample validation (wrong-pose record sub-case of test_batch_missing_pad_wrong_pose_and_tick_jump_are_atomic, tests/tasks/test_native_parcel_rpc.py line ~143). Not fixable inside native_parcel_rpc.py without duplicating stage-owned source semantics.
